## A real sample

**This is the part that matters.** An adapter cannot be written or tested from documentation, so
without a file this issue will stay open and unimplemented. That is not a useful outcome for
either of us.

Attach the smallest session that still shows the shape of the format, and **read it first**: a
transcript contains whatever you pasted while working, which can include credentials, private
code, and screenshots. Redact freely. Twenty records is plenty. A whole day is not needed.
